scope: Local persistent SQLite native read capacity and isolation validation; not deployed large Bunny catalog acceptance
consistency_cases: Actual independent SQLite writer commits a changed unread row after page one; active native reader retains original revision/data and next reader sees the update
Lost second-page baton refuses partial bucket
Incorrect bucket record count refuses read
Quoted SQL-like bucket key remains parameterized and does not include another bucket
limitations: Individual rows must fit bounded transport
Complete bucket and metadata-index collections remain in memory for original interfaces
Receipt metadata still sorts in memory with original .NET ordinal semantics
Large live Bunny capacity, deployed MC/Edge image, migration and production gates remain open
